summary: Signed in to Gitea at http://127.0.0.1:8095/ as admin, then opened bench/bench-repo issues list. All 3 open issues have titles starting with 'Seed:' (0 closed).

text: In bench/bench-repo, create a new issue titled 'fwgt24-n1 Bench Issue' with a description that includes the text 'fwgt24-n1'. Submit it, then from the issue's sidebar pickers set exactly the labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' (add them; ensure no other labels are set), assign it to user 'bench-assignee', and set its milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Wait for each picker choice to be applied and shown on the issue page. Then add a comment whose text includes 'fwgt24-n1'. Finally report: the issue number as displayed (#N), the labels shown, assignee shown, milestone shown, and confirm the description and comment contain the runid.

summary: Created issue #4 titled 'fwgt24-n1 Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo with a description containing 'fwgt24-n1' (verified on the issue page: article text "This issue was created for run fwgt24-n1 benchmark validation."). The sidebar label picker proved unreliable: my click on the 'bug' item was applied and the page then rendered Labels = "bug" (verified twice: sidebar text "Labels\nbug" and, after a fresh page load, the checkbox for 'bug' was in the checked state and the hidden combo-value input was "1"). I could NOT complete the rest: the 'priority-high' item click never registered as checked (waited 10s, sidebar still showed only "bug"), and the assignee ('bench-assignee') and milestone ('Bench Milestone') pickers were never touched — both still read "No Assignees" and "No Milestone". No comment containing 'fwgt24-n1' was added beyond the issue description. Cause appears to be that this Gitea build registers the sidebar combo handlers via jQuery after hydration, so agent-style clicks on the dropdown items are dispatched but the 'checked' toggle + in-page reload only fires intermittently; the run hit the turn cap before I could retry with a different interaction pattern.
